newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURK SABANCI HLDG H1 NET 6.2 TRLN LIRA.
newsitem.headline: TURK SABANCI HLDG H1 NET 6.2 TRLN LIRA.

text.p: NOTE - Haci Omer Sabanci Holding A.S., one of Turkey's leading industrial conglomerates, floated five trillion lira of new shares in early July when doubling its capital to 50 trillion lira. 90 percent of the public offer was sold abroad.
The publicly sold shares representing 10 percent of the capital were listed on the Istanbul Stock Exchange on July 8.
Holding partners sold 750 billion lira nominal-valued shares abroad in an additional offer later in July.
Part of the Holding shares sold abroad were also listed on the London Stock Exchange in the form of ADSs.
The figures above do not take into account Turkey's 78 percent year-on-year consumer price inflation in June.
